messages:
Maria L: Quick sync — need to lock down span naming + attributes for inference traces (model, tokens, cache, routing). I opened a short PR but want platform + runtime buy-in before merging.
Evan K: Sounds good. My gut: span name = `inference.request` (keep OTEL generic). set `service.name` = `redwood.inference`.
Olivia P: Agree on `inference.request`. For model: use `llm.model.name` (family) and `llm.model.version` (ver string). Avoid sending full model git/sha as indexed attr.
Rahul S: Token counts: include numeric attrs `llm.tokens.input` and `llm.tokens.output`. Also emit `llm.tokens.total` for convenience. For index-friendly dashboards add `llm.tokens.bucket` (enum: small/med/large).
Cassie: Cache semantics: emit `redwood.cache.hit` (bool). optional `redwood.cache.type` limited to {"prefix","kv","none"}. Do not put raw keys in attributes.
Maria L: Good call on buckets. Also we need routing/quota attrs: `redwood.route.policy` (eg "latency","cost","region") and `redwood.quota_id` (small id string) so billing/ops can join traces.
Evan K: One more: rollout metadata -> `redwood.rollout_variant` (can be empty). Keep these as low-cardinality strings.
Olivia P: About model.version cardinality — telemetry backends hate high-cardinality. Mark `llm.model.version` as non-indexed in exporter mapping and only index `llm.model.name`.
Rahul S: Sampling rules proposal: default trace sampling 1% for success and latency < 200ms. Force-sample (100%) for errors (status >= 500), latency > 2s, or when `redwood.cache.hit=false` and `llm.tokens.total > 2000`. That helps catch costly ops.
Cassie: Exporters: for OTLP -> clickhouse we should strip the `request.payload` and any PII. Keep full token counts but avoid exporting prompt text.
Maria L: Agreed. Also retention: keep indexed attrs for 90 days, raw spans (non-indexed) 7 days in hot storage, archive to cold for 1 year. Ops will need an ILM plan.
Evan K: Small example snippet for the spec: 
```
span.name = "inference.request"
attributes = {
  "service.name": "redwood.inference",
  "llm.model.name": "gpt-redwood-3",
  "llm.model.version": "2025-02-10",  # non-indexed
  "llm.tokens.input": 312,
  "llm.tokens.output": 48,
  "llm.tokens.total": 360,
  "llm.tokens.bucket": "med",
  "redwood.cache.hit": false,
  "redwood.cache.type": "kv",
  "redwood.route.policy": "latency",
  "redwood.quota_id": "q-87",
  "redwood.rollout_variant": "canary-2"
}
```
Rahul S: That looks perfect. We should also add `trace.attributes.llm.input_truncated` (bool) if we clipped prompts.
Cassie: One more ops ask: include `net.region` or `net.peer.region` so dashboard can show cross-region traffic.
Maria L: OK action items: Evan to update PR with spec + exporter rules (mark model.version non-indexed, drop prompt/text), Rahul to add sampling rules to agent, Olivia to add docs for SDK (which attrs to attach), Cassie to update retention/ILM proposal.
Tracebot: PR 312 merged into `telemetry/specs`? Not yet — comment added with requested changes.
Maria L: Thanks — once PR updated I'll schedule a 15m sync with infra + platform to approve retention and exporter mappings.
Evan K: I'll push the PR changes this afternoon.
Olivia P: I'll stub the SDK examples.
Rahul S: I'll drop the sampling rules into the sampling service config and add test cases.
Cassie: I'll coordinate with observability for ILM.
Maria L: Great. If anybody has a hard no on naming/attrs shout now, otherwise we converge tomorrow. :+1:
